questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward. This hand signal means all riders should increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic light colors from bottom to top are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A hand signal is used instead of or with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When the lead rider raises their left arm and points with their index finger, the group should form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let existing traffic go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. Do not use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with white background and black markings. You must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery and your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead. You should slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, this hand signal tells following riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it is a regulatory sign that prohibits an action. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must come to a complete stop and yield to other traffic. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep right. An obstacle like a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign showing a law you must obey. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road when conditions are good. You may need to drive slower in bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow merging vehicles to safely enter your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a stop sign is coming up. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to make a complete stop. You must yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Proceed only when it is safe.
